brief: Prioritise Ashford Crossing for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Review the asset's open defect register as governed by SOP-016 to re-prioritise outstanding work affecting its ability to shed heat. Check maintenance compliance records following REG-042, bearing in mind that time elapsed since the last completed maintenance bounds how current the recorded condition can be.
